criteria: Separate dispatched failure from certainty of remote effect.
Normalize RFC 9457 before application mapping; use conservative unknown outcomes.
Base compatibility on actual readers, writers, relay path and configuration, not labels.
Cover supported rollout, rollback and retained payload pairs proportionately.
Bound CDC evidence to executed interactions and fixture states.

findingsRetained.evidence: Actual generated clients, resolved versions, selected mapper and coexistence pairs are required. Jackson 2.18.3, Jackson 3.0.0, Boot 3.5.0 and Framework 6.2.7 source confirms the version-sensitive defaults stated.
findingsRetained.consequence: A custom mapper cannot inherit a tolerance guarantee merely from the Boot label. No redundant workflow added.

findingsRetained.evidence: RFC 9457 confirms optional standard members, ignoring wrong-typed members, default type, URI resolution, unknown extensions and advisory body status.
findingsRetained.consequence: Typed mapping is downstream of normalization, while untrusted or missing evidence cannot authorize mutation retry.

findingsRetained.evidence: gRPC status documentation says DEADLINE_EXCEEDED can follow successful effect and non-idempotent UNAVAILABLE retries may be unsafe. The skill distinguishes ABORTED and state repair.
findingsRetained.consequence: No new status-to-universal-retry rule or cancellation completion guarantee is needed.

findingsRetained.evidence: Protobuf documents unknown-field loss through JSON/field copying and explicit-presence round-trip loss; Avro 1.12 documents reader defaults and reader-side aliases; Confluent distinguishes FULL from FULL_TRANSITIVE.
findingsRetained.consequence: The existing pair/path and value/presence checks preserve protocol and semantic compatibility without universal dual-writing.

findingsRetained.evidence: Pact documents consumer assertions, provider interactions/states and environment-version deployment checks.
findingsRetained.consequence: Existing guidance does not turn registered interactions into proof of all business behavior, unregistered clients or unexecuted pairs.

findingsRetained.evidence: RFC 9110 confirms strong comparison for If-Match and Retry-After as HTTP-date or non-negative integer seconds.
findingsRetained.consequence: Existing atomic precondition guidance and bounded delay handling are retained.

evaluator.changedConstraint: Only the factory return statement changes from builder.build() to new ObjectMapper(); all versions, fixtures, callers and deployment facts remain identical.
